decks.py generate persists edits_applied dict ONLY for fields that were in the edits payload (research_question / slides_edited / audience_assumed), then snapshots the post-edit research_question/slides/audience_assumed onto the outline record so admin telemetry sees what was actually generated. Clean.

admin_llm_spend.deck_quality alert window logic — sorts rows by created_at desc per account, slices first 5, counts those <55. With only 4 telemetry rows for bramuel the window=4 is correct (not padded). avg_score is over the full window not just weak ones — by design (matches PRD wording 'avg of last N').
